page.summary_zh: 现货交易就是用自己账户里的钱直接买币，不借钱、没有杠杆。市价单立即成交但成交价可能略有偏差；限价单由你定价格，但可能不成交。挂在盘口等待成交的是挂单（Maker），立即成交的是吃单（Taker），费率可能不同。以 0.1% 吃单费率计算，100 USDT 的手续费约 0.1 USDT；另外要注意简易买币页面可能包含点差。
checklist_zh: 确认自己在"现货"页面，而不是合约页面
想立即成交用市价，想控制价格用限价
在官方费率页确认挂单/吃单费率
下单前看清最终成交价和手续费

quiz.q: 现货交易和合约交易最大的区别是？
quiz.why: 现货是用自己的钱直接买币；合约涉及保证金和杠杆，是另一种产品。

options: 你定价格，但可能不成交
quiz.answer: 你定价格，但可能不成交
quiz.why: 只有市场价格到达你设定的价格时，限价单才会成交。

quiz.q: 100 USDT 市价买入，吃单费率 0.1%，手续费约是？

faq.q: 现货和合约有什么区别？
faq.a: 现货是用自己的钱直接买币，没有杠杆；合约是用保证金交易价格变化，可以加杠杆，亏损也会被放大。新手先从现货开始。

faq.q: Maker 和 Taker 是什么？
faq.a: 挂在盘口等待别人成交的订单是 Maker（挂单）；立即和现有报价成交的是 Taker（吃单）。很多平台两者费率不同，以官方费率页为准。

faq.q: 为什么实际成交价和我看到的不一样？
faq.a: 市价单按当时可成交的价格成交，价格变化快时会有偏差；简易买币页面的报价也可能包含点差。

page.summary_en: Spot trading means buying crypto directly with the money in your account, without borrowing and without leverage. A market order fills immediately, but the fill price may differ slightly; a limit order lets you set the price, but it may not fill. An order waiting on the book is a maker order; an order that fills immediately against existing quotes is a taker order. Fees can differ. At a 0.1% taker fee, the fee on 100 USDT is about 0.1 USDT. Also remember that simple buy pages may include a spread.
checklist_en: I have confirmed I am on the spot page, not the futures page
I use market orders for immediate fills and limit orders to control price
I have checked maker/taker fees on the official fee page
I read the final fill price and fee before placing the order
I use only a small amount for the first trade

quiz_en.q: What is the biggest difference between spot trading and futures?
options: Spot uses your own money and has no leverage
quiz_en.answer: Spot uses your own money and has no leverage
quiz_en.why: Spot means buying crypto directly with your own money. Futures involve margin and leverage and are a different product.

options: You set the price, but it may not fill
quiz_en.answer: You set the price, but it may not fill
quiz_en.why: A limit order fills only if the market reaches your chosen price.

quiz_en.q: If you buy 100 USDT at market with a 0.1% taker fee, about how much is the fee?

faq_en.q: What is the difference between spot and futures?
faq_en.a: Spot means buying crypto directly with your own money and no leverage. Futures use margin to trade price changes, can add leverage, and can magnify losses. Beginners should start with spot.
An order that waits on the order book is Maker. An order that immediately fills against an existing quote is Taker. Many platforms charge different fees for each; use the official fee page.

faq_en.q: Why is the actual fill price different from what I saw?
faq_en.a: A market order fills at the prices available at that moment, so fast-moving prices can create a difference. Simple buy pages may also include a spread.
